transcript: Drink boiled bay leaves and just watch what happens to your body. Add five to six bay leaves to a small pot with two cups of water. Simmer for five to eight minutes until the water turns golden. Then strain it into a cup. Drink this in the morning and again midday with your meals. In the ancient texts, bay leaves are known for their powerful compounds that steady blood sugar, calm inflammation and support digestion. After 14 days you will know this is more than just something you cook with. Your energy will shift. Your body will begin to feel lighter and some even say their waist begins to tighten. Comment yes if you are going to try this my friend and follow for more ancient healing.
